variants.name: a_columns_clean_loop
variants.note: Patched $direct.columns ONLY (keeping the 4-way branch for symbol(s&3, m)): eliminate 4 inner-loop [rbp-] spills (-0x78 left, -0x88 neg, -0x90 mh>>31, -0x98 diff+1), eliminate the 6-op (%rsp) backedge parallel-copy bounce, hoist both loop-invariant `test %r10` array null-checks out of the loop, emit 1-insn `notl` instead of `mov $0xffffffff; xor`, and use bottom-tested loop (`sub $1; jne`). Saves 18.6% (1.23x).

variants.name: b_columns_plus_indexed_mask
variants.note: Also pack the 4 loop-invariant Masks4 fields into a contiguous 4-word stack slot before the loop and replace the 4-way branch chain for `symbol(s & 3, m)` with a single indexed load `mov -0xc0(%rbp,%rax,8), %edi` (matching gcc-10's `mov -0x58(%rsp,%rdx,4), %eax`). Alone saves another 63 ms -> 32.7% total (1.485x -> 1.730x C).

variants.name: c_build_masks_inplace
variants.note: SMOKING GUN #2: Patched $direct.build_masks ONLY (972 lines of asm!): previously freed and re-allocated a 4-word heap `Masks4{a,b,c,d}` ctor on EVERY bit (32 iters x 9 stripes x 4 pairs x 4096 reps = 4.7M wasted heap Masks4 alloc/frees + p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks!). Mutating the unique Masks4 cell in place with a single indexed `or %r10, (%rdi,%rax,8)` inside a 15-insn bottom-tested loop saves 24.2% (1.32x) all by itself!

variants.name: bc_columns_plus_build_masks
variants.note: Combined clean $direct.columns + indexed mask load + in-place $direct.build_masks cuts 54.8% of total runtime (2.21x speedup -> 1.161x C!). Remaining 28 ms gap vs C's 174 ms is Bend's 2 KiB heap-allocated 256-slot U32 Array per pair vs C's 256 B stack uint8_t[256] + $direct.stripes Tuple/Masks4 plumbing.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (Perceus IReuse / in-place field update for unique single-ctor records in TCO loops + contiguous-slot indexed projection for uniform-field records + clean spill-free/hoisted-nullcheck/register-swap TCO backedge: 2.21x -> 1.161x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~160 LOC (~70 LOC Perceus IReuse / in-place field update in TCO loops, ~40 LOC uniform-field record indexed load/update, ~50 LOC TCO loop spill/backedge-bounce/nullcheck-hoist + notl)

variants.name: a_merge_dispatch_ireuse
variants.note: Patched $direct.merge ONLY (shrunk from 2835 B to 265 B!): (1) replace 9-way sequential Cartesian `(a_tag, b_tag)` compare chain (which put hot `Mnode/Mnode` LAST after 12 branches!) with a 3-way nested decision tree checking `Mnode` first, (2) Perceus in-place `IReuse` of `a` in `Mnode/Mnode` (free `b` to free[1], overwrite `a`'s 2 fields in place, ZERO Mnode allocations and ZERO p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks!). Alone cuts 43.7% (1.78x -> 1.201x C).

variants.name: ab_merge_plus_branchless_radix
variants.note: Also patched $direct.radix (214 B vs 972 B): replace random-bit branch (`n & k`) duplicating two Mnode alloc blocks with branchless `cmovne` swap of `(r, Free{})`, hoist tls/heap/tags, drop p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks, and bottom-test the 24-iter loop. Brings tree-radix to 1.179x C (1.81x speedup, 44.7% saved; 1278-1285 ms on clean runs vs 1136 ms C).

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (Perceus in-place IReuse on matched unique CTORs + nested decision-tree match dispatch + branchless cmov for 2-arm ctor-field swap: 1.81x -> 1.179x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~180 LOC (~100 LOC Perceus IReuse [shared with tree-bitonic & tree-matmul], ~50 LOC nested decision-tree multi-scrutinee match, ~30 LOC branchless cmov swap_bits)

variants.name: a_mul_borrow_walk
variants.note: SMOKING GUN #1: In $direct.mul(+a, +b), `a` and `b` are shared (`+`), so `(a0|a1|a2|a3) >> 57 != 0` is 100% ALWAYS TRUE and EVERY `Qd` match fell back to out-of-line `callq p111_rt_take` followed by 8 more `keep` RC++ ops! Replacing $direct.mul with a read-only borrow-walk `mul_borrow` (0 p111_rt_take, 0 keep/RC++ inside recursion, dropping root `a` and `b` once via p111_rt_sink at top-level exit) saves 17.6% (1.21x) while remaining 100% ABI-compliant.

variants.name: ab_mul_borrow_plus_add_ireuse
variants.note: Also patched $direct.add (67.1M Lf/Lf + 9.6M Qd/Qd calls!) with Perceus in-place `IReuse` (overwrite `a`'s Lf/Qd cell in place and free `b` directly to free[0]/free[2], handling both unique and RC=1 boxed nodes). Cuts 47.4% of total runtime (1.90x speedup -> 3.17x C; eliminates the >30s timeout at nchain=384: ~48.8s -> ~25.7s!). CRITICAL REMAINING GAP DIAGNOSED: `p111_cid_hot[0x28]` (for Qd) forces `p111_rt_ctor` to eagerly allocate 4 separate 1-word RC boxes for every Qd's 4 children even on ephemeral intermediate Qd trees immediately consumed by `add` (~38.4M wasted RC-box alloc/free pairs!).

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (read-only borrow-walk on shared recursive Data match + Perceus IReuse on unique/RC=1 CTORs: 1.90x -> 3.17x C, eliminates >30s timeout; lazy RC-boxing for ephemeral Qd trees would close most of the remaining gap)
probes.estimated_loc: ~180 LOC (~80 LOC read-only borrow-walk [shared with symreg & hashmap], ~100 LOC Perceus IReuse [shared with tree-radix & tree-bitonic])

variants.name: a_eval_borrow_walk
variants.note: CRUSHES gcc-10 -O2 BY 2.28x (0.439x C; 3.89x speedup, 74.3% saved)! SMOKING GUN: $direct.eval(e, +x) evaluates a shared (`+e`) depth-5 AST 110 times per candidate (227M calls). Because `e` is shared and `(a|b) >> 57 != 0`, 100% of Add/Sub/Mul/Xor nodes fell back to out-of-line `callq p111_rt_take`! Replacing $direct.eval with a 280-byte read-only `eval_borrow(heap, e, x)` (0 p111_rt_take, 0 RC++/RC-- inside recursion, dropping root `e` once at top-level exit, sharing the binary-op deref+2-call sequence across Add/Sub/Mul/Xor, zero frame pointer) obliterates 74.3% of runtime!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (read-only borrow-walk on recursive Data match + shared binary-op tail merging + zero-frame leaf fast-path: 3.89x -> 0.439x C, beats gcc-10 -O2 by 2.28x!)
probes.estimated_loc: ~110 LOC (~80 LOC read-only borrow-walk [same pass as tree-matmul & hashmap!], ~30 LOC common binary-op tail sharing & leaf zero-frame)

variants.name: a_solve_decision_tree_unspill
variants.note: Patched $direct.solve keeping the EXACT 14-arg Bend ABI & recursion structure: (1) zero-frame leaf early-out for `z == True || f == 0` (50%+ of calls!), (2) replace 8-way repeated-test Cartesian match with a clean decision tree (test z once, e once), (3) shrink 552-byte frame (`sub $0x228, %rsp`) + 170 [rbp-] spills to a compact 64-byte frame keeping cols/ld/rd/full/sib in registers, (4) emit `neg` instead of `xor; sub; mov %edi,%edi` and unpack returned `(sols, nodes)` directly without round-tripping `ret` tag. Alone saves 43.3% (1.76x -> 1.72x C)!

variants.name: b_solve_worker_wrapper_reg_abi
variants.note: BEATS gcc-10 -O2 BY 4.7% (0.953x C; 3.18x speedup, 68.6% saved)! Worker/wrapper specialization for self-recursive functions: drop unused `ctx`, constant `ret=Stat0`, dead fuel `f`, and precomputed booleans `z`/`e` from the internal recursive ABI -> 5-register `solve_worker(cand, cols, ld, rd, full)` returning `(sols, nodes)` in `(%eax, %edx)` with zero stack args and skipping recursive call when `cc == 0`!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (nested decision-tree match + zero-frame leaf early-out + compact regalloc + neg: 1.76x -> 1.72x C; + worker/wrapper dead/redundant-param elimination for self-recursive defs: 3.18x -> 0.953x C, beats gcc-10 -O2!)
probes.estimated_loc: ~180 LOC (~50 LOC nested decision-tree match [shared with tree-radix], ~40 LOC zero-frame leaf early-out + neg, ~90 LOC self-recursive worker/wrapper dead-param & stack-arg elim)
